observations: A truck loaded with stacks of wooden pallets.
The pallets appear to be standard shipping pallets made of light-colored wood.
Visible pallets seem intact from the rear view.
A watermark 'PALLETVOID' is visible across the center of the image.
The pallets are stacked in a box truck or container.

claims.evidence: Load-bearing capacity cannot be determined from a photo.
Wood grade and joint integrity require physical inspection.

risks.risk: Internal structural damage or broken slats not visible from the stack ends.
risks.proof: Photos of individual pallets laid out flat, front and back.
risks.if_unproven: priced as scrap or damaged wood

risks.risk: Pest infestation (termites or wood borers) or rot.
risks.proof: Close-up shots of the wood grain and joints.
Photos of heat-treatment (HT) or chemical-treatment (MB) stamps on the pallet blocks.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of a single pallet showing its full surface and any stamps/markings.
Dimensions (length, width, and height) of the pallets.
Confirmation of the wood type (e.g., hardwood or softwood).
response.reason: The items are clearly identifiable as wooden pallets. They can be priced at the base market rate for used wooden pallets in Lagos, assuming the worst-case condition for unverified structural integrity.
